name: fitbot-monorepo
description: Root script to run FitBot full stack

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "API,ADMIN,READY" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run start:dev --prefix fitbot-api" "npm run dev --prefix fitbot-admin" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 http://localhost:3001 && echo. && echo '---------------------------------------' && echo '🚀 GYMBOT IS READY!' && echo 'API: http://localhost:3000' && echo 'ADMIN: http://localhost:3001' && echo '---------------------------------------'"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix fitbot-api && npm install --prefix fitbot-admin
